_comment: #409 idle probe. Two-plus captures per map, spaced 20 engine frames = NOMINALLY 2 animation ticks at fps 6. The gap matters: a 4-frame idle repeats every 4 ticks, so any gap that is a multiple of 4 makes a WORKING animation photograph as frozen. 2 is the safe target -- one tick of scheduler jitter either way lands on 1 or 3, never 0. (The original 50-frame gap was 5 ticks, chosen when the idles were 2 frames and only ODDNESS mattered; after the #409-review widening to 4 frames it drifted to 4 ticks between the 2nd and 3rd boulevard captures and produced two byte-identical PNGs.)
